title: cs daily scratchpad - QBRs + renewals - 2026-03-28
content:
Morning scratchpad - 2026-03-28

Top priorities for today:
- QBR prep: FinTechCo (Apr 2) - finalize slides and one-pager. Need usage + cost trends, SLA incidents summary, suggestions for cost optimizations (batching + caching rec), and rollout plan for new quantized model.
- Renewal outreach: Acme Corp - renewal due 2026-05-12 (6 weeks). Confirm draft MSA + pricing options with Sales and Legal.
- High-priority support follow-ups: ticket JIRA-CS-7891 (latency regression), JIRA-CS-7920 (embedding drift).

Quick schedule:
- 10:00 AM - sync w/ Maya (FinTechCo slide review) - bring sample charts (tokens/day, p50/p95 latency, cost/token)
- 11:30 AM - renewal check-in w/ Sales (Priya) - discuss tiered discounts + dedicated capacity offer
- 3:00 PM - SRE triage for JIRA-CS-7891
- 4:15 PM - end-of-day quick recap + update QBR doc

Action items (today):
- [ ] Populate FinTechCo metrics table: last 30 days usage (tokens), monthly spend delta, top 3 endpoints by volume - owner: Daniel - due: EOD 3/28
- [ ] Add incident timeline (Feb 15 outage) and mitigation steps - owner: Maya - due: 3/28 AM
- [ ] Draft 2 pricing scenarios for Acme renewal (standard + dedicated discount) - owner: Alex - due: 3/29
- [ ] Follow up with Eng on latency regression root cause (assign to SRE on-call) - owner: Daniel - due: 3/28 3pm triage
- [ ] Send pre-read to FinTechCo contacts (product + infra) - owner: Daniel - due: 3/29

Support tickets snapshot:
- JIRA-CS-7891: "p95 latency up ~30% after 3/10 deploy" - current owner: eng/sre-team. Notes: SLO alert triggered 3/13, rollback attempted on 3/14 (partial), monitoring shows KV cache hit rate dropped. Action: request logs from runtime team, capture kernel/quantization change list.
- JIRA-CS-7920: "embedding drift for recommendations" - product is asking for sample evals and embedding config. Action: create small eval set and run baseline vs current model.

Renewals & commercial notes:
- Acme Corp renewal timeline: renewal notice sent (60 days) -> check legal redlines by 3/31 -> offer deadline 4/15 -> renewal effective 5/12.
- Consider pitching Redwood Dedicated as option to control cost variance for them (their usage spiky). Prepare cost comparison: hosted vs dedicated vs hybrid caching.

Prep checklist for FinTechCo QBR:
- One-pager (1p): topline health, risks, opportunities - STATUS: draft (Maya)
- Slides: 8-10 slides - STATUS: outline done, need charts (Daniel)
- Follow-ups list: action owners + timeline - STATUS: in progress
- Exec summary email to send 2 days before QBR - template exists in Confluence link above

Notes to self / things to remember:
- When discussing cost, call out batching and prefix cache wins (have a couple of anonymized % savings examples handy).
- If asked about outages, be transparent: state incident, RCA timeline, and current mitigations (fallback models + auto-fallback routing).
- Ask FinTechCo if they'd be open to a dedicated capacity pilot (2-week burst test) - could help with retention and show cost predictability.

Links & refs quick list:
- Confluence: FinTechCo QBR template -> https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CS/FinTechCo+QBR+template
- Jira: JIRA-CS-7891, JIRA-CS-7920
- Slack: #cs-fintecho (thread "QBR prep")
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/412 (chart updates for tokens/day)

Yesterday notes (useful context):
- Spoke w/ Eng about KV cache hit drop - they suspect a model variant rollout on 3/9 changed cache key patterns. Eng will run a backfill test.
- Sales confirmed Acme is evaluating cost predictability. Good signal to push dedicated/commit options.

Risks / blockers:
- Legal turnaround time for Acme redlines could push renewal timeline - flag to Sales now.
- Eng capacity: latency regression triage might take >1 day; set expectation with FinTechCo that we may have interim workarounds (route to fallback model).

End-of-day updates to add here:
- [space to paste final notes, outcomes of 3pm triage, and updated slide links]

Random TODO (personal):
- [ ] Submit timecard for last week (ugh)
- [ ] Move QBR deck to shared folder and set viewer permissions for FinTechCo contacts
